//: The studio needs its own tsconfig. Without one, TypeScript walks up to the
repository root and finds the Astro config, which extends
'astro/tsconfigs/strict'. That resolves locally only because the root
node_modules happens to contain Astro. On Cloudflare the admin site builds
with root directory 'studio', so only these dependencies are installed and
the extends fails with: File 'astro/tsconfigs/strict' not found.
Having this file here stops the lookup from ever leaving the folder.
